title: AI SDK generateText on Inferlo's AI with an Inferlo tool
prompt: Part of the team writes AI code with the Vercel AI SDK (the ai package). Create src/routes/ask.ts exporting `ask`: POST /ask with body { question } (a string of at most 4000 characters) that answers { answer } (a string). Also export a function tool `orderStatus` named "orderStatus" (description "Status of an order") whose input is { orderId } (a string) and which returns { orderId, status: "shipped" }. In the handler, call generateText from ai with the system prompt "You answer support questions.", the question as the prompt, at most 5 steps (stopWhen: stepCountIs(5)), a model that is the request's Inferlo AI client through Inferlo's AI SDK integration using the "fast" alias and tracking usage for the signed-in user, and the orderStatus tool through the same integration. Answer with the generated text. Register the route module in src/app.ts.
